name: Soul Scourge
description: A Ghost Rider/Spawn hybrid who no longer has the man behind the demon to rein them in. Now the entity is free to ride on the land burning the souls of their victims, good or bad.

soul_burn.title: Soul Burn
soul_burn.description: Burn the soul of your target, dealing damage over time and applying a debuff that lowers their defense.
commands: execute at @s run damage @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,sort=nearest,limit=1,distance=..8] 4 minecraft:magic by @s
execute at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,sort=nearest,limit=1,distance=..8] minecraft:wither 5 1 true
execute at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,type=!fms:motorcycle,type=!fms:charger,sort=nearest,limit=1,distance=..8] minecraft:weakness 5 1 true

summon_ride.title: Summon Ride
summon_ride.description: Summon your demonic steed to ride on. While riding, you gain increased movement speed and the ability to trample enemies.
commands: execute at @s unless entity @s[predicate=eop:is_sneaking] run summon fms:motorcycle ~ ~ ~ {Tags:["soul_scourge_ride"]}
execute at @s if entity @s[predicate=eop:is_sneaking] run summon fms:charger ~ ~ ~ {Tags:["soul_scourge_ride"]}
execute unless entity @s[predicate=eop:is_sneaking] run ride @s mount @e[type=fms:motorcycle,tag=soul_scourge_ride,sort=nearest,limit=1,distance=..8]
execute if entity @s[predicate=eop:is_sneaking] run ride @s mount @e[type=fms:charger,tag=soul_scourge_ride,sort=nearest,limit=1,distance=..8]

dismiss_ride.title: Dismiss Ride
dismiss_ride.description: Dismiss your currently summoned demonic ride.
